title: Simulation-instrument freeze manifest v1
description: Machine-checkable freeze surface for a preregistered simulation instrument of the emergent-adequacy program (V3 lane #737). One manifest per preregistration instance, committed with the instance document. Companion to docs/INSTRUMENT_PREREGISTRATION_TEMPLATE_V1.md.

campaign_id.description: Unique campaign id; exactly one campaign is ever executed under it.

instrument_id.description: Upstream instrument-register row id (e.g. INS-02), or 'pending-registration'.

ledger_row.description: Exactly one observation-ledger row this instrument binds to.

composition_lane.description: Exactly one composition lane (upstream issue reference).

stage.description: Lifecycle stage per the template. S0 SPECIFIED work carries no manifest.

freeze_utc.description: Non-future UTC time of the freeze commit.

execution_authorized.description: False until the owning issue's run authorization exists. Must be false at stage S1 and S2.

state.description: 'declared' at S1/S2 (procedure pinned, no integer drawn); 'committed' at S3 (seed table committed before any run).

derivation.description: Verbatim per-run seed derivation rule from the master seed.

template.description: The template version this instance follows, pinned.

driver.description: The frozen driver. Required at stage S2 and later; absent at S1.

pinned_code.description: Every code path the analysis depends on, pinned at the freeze commit.

decision_rule_verdicts.description: The frozen decision rule must name all three verdicts.

equal_prominence.description: Negative and control outcomes are reported with the same prominence as positive ones. Constant by construction.

claim_boundary_summary.description: One-paragraph verbatim claim boundary: what a positive verdict promotes and what it never claims.

repository_head.description: Full hash of the repository base commit that precedes the freeze artifacts in branch history; it need not be their direct parent or the freeze commit itself.
